messages:
Priya: quick heads-up from today's onboarding + health check with Silverline — pulled the top feedback items, some could affect renewal. can we triage?
Liam: thanks. can you paste the notes/raw asks?
Priya: raw notes below:
- Feature ask: per-team API quotas / delegation so org admins can split quotas across teams
- Pain: no visibility into embedding debug logs — customers see duplicates but can't trace root cause
- Performance ask: long cold-starts for Private deployments on initial burst
- Renewal risk: Silverline wants predictable monthly spend, said they'll pause feature rollout if unclear
- Small UX: console sample prompts / copy examples requested by onboarding
Marcus: is Silverline already flagged as renewal-risk in our tracker?
Priya: yes — renewal review next month. they called it out explicitly during the session.
Liam: how would you rank severity 1 (blocker) - 3 (nice-to-have)?
Priya: Silverline risk = 1, per-team quotas = 2, embedding logs = 2, cold-start = 3, console samples = 3.
Anya: quick wins: console samples (30m mock), add correlation-id to embedding responses/logs (2d), quota page mock (1d).
Sam: i'll create GH issues and add cs notes / labels if folks agree (cs:high-risk, p1/p2).
Liam: @Sam please create and link to the roadmap board. also @Priya can you paste the customer repro (or attach the support ticket)?
Priya: pasted snippet from support ticket #12345: "monthly spend spikes unpredictably, need forecast by route and per-team; admin needs to cap team usage" — I'll attach the ticket link in the doc.
Marcus: for per-team quotas: Dedicated has isolation but not delegation UI. we might reuse billing quotas but would need API + console changes.
Anya: agreed. console change looks small; backend quota enforcement needs design. propose spike first.
Liam: proposed owners: quotas = Liam (spike), console samples = Anya, embedding logs = Marcus (instrumentation), GH issues + triage = Sam, customer follow-up = Priya.
Sam: created issues and attached notes: https://github.com/redwood/roadmap/issues/987 (added cs:high-risk, p1 for Silverline)
Priya: awesome, thx. next steps: i'll run a 15-min intake with Silverline Thurs 10am PT — @Liam @Anya pls join. i'll post link here.
Anya: i'll post a quick Figma mock in this thread after lunch.
Marcus: i'll scope required telemetry changes and post a short plan by EOD Friday.
Liam: i'll slot the quota spike into next sprint grooming and add acceptance criteria (API, UX, migration notes).
Priya: thanks everyone — feels good to have owners. i'll update the renewal tracker and escalate if anything changes. :pray:
Sam: thumbs up — will keep the issues updated with customer comments.
Priya: closing loop here — will share meeting invite + support ticket link shortly. :calendar:
thread_text_snippet: Silverline risk + per-team quotas + embedding logs triage
